evidence_cards.content: If correlation is found with a track for which another C2 JU has Responsibility (R2) and the Track Numbers (TNs) are the same, the JU shall accept the PPLI information for its Surveillance JU type and shall disregard the J3 surveillance data on the specific track except when Position Quality in the PPLI message is '0' (Point In Time); in that case, the track number and identity provided in the PPLI message shall be discarded.
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: Specifies the alternative flow logic for handling track data with shared responsibility.

evidence_cards.content: For each of the Platform, Platform Activity, Specific Type, and Special Interest Indicator fields implemented by a C² JU, the JU (NonC2 JU) shall accept all defined field values for retransmission and operator appreciation, in the event of assuming R² for a previously-reported track.
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: This claim describes the primary action of the NonC2 JU (accepting data values) during the situational awareness flow when assuming responsibility for a track (R²).

evidence_cards.content: Values accepted for retransmission shall be retransmitted if the JU assumes R², unless the JU holds locally derived data other than No Statement (non-NS) for the field which differs from the value accepted for retransmission.
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: This claim details the specific condition under which the NonC2 JU retransmits the received data, defining the system's behavior in the main flow.

evidence_cards.content: If the JU holds locally derived data (non-NS) that differs from the received value, the JU shall report the locally derived data instead of retransmitting the received value.
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: This claim specifies the logic for handling locally derived data versus received data, a critical step in the processing flow.

evidence_cards.content: Non-NS data for the Platform, Platform Activity, and Specific Type fields received from the controlling unit for the track shall be retransmitted regardless of locally derived data.
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: This claim defines a mandatory retransmission rule for specific fields, ensuring data consistency in the situational awareness flow.

evidence_cards.content: If the Special Interest Indicator is set to value 1, it shall be retransmitted as value 1 by any JU assuming R².
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: This claim specifies a specific retransmission requirement for the Special Interest Indicator field.

evidence_cards.content: When a track's IFF/SIF data changes from a No Data status (zero code) to Valid Data status (nonzero code), the JU transmits a J7.5 (ACT = 1) message to report the difference.
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: Specifies a main flow action (sending a specific message) triggered by a data state change, describing the interaction between the system and the JU.

evidence_cards.content: When a track's IFF/SIF data changes from one Valid Data value to a different Valid Data value, the JU transmits a J7.5 (ACT = 1) message to report the difference.
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: Specifies the main flow action (sending a specific message) for data updates, describing the interaction between the system and the JU.

evidence_cards.content: A JU without R2 status (NonC2 JU) transmits a J7.5 (ACT = 1) message when locally entered IFF/SIF data changes from a different value to another value, or in response to a J3.XC1 'NO DATA' report.

evidence_cards.content: A JU assumes R² for a locally held Air or Surface (Maritime) track if no remote report is received for approximately 40 seconds, or for a locally held Land (Ground) track if no remote report is received for approximately 120 seconds.
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: Defines the specific timing conditions under which the actor (NonC2 JU) takes control of a track based on lack of incoming surveillance data, a critical part of the interaction flow.

evidence_cards.content: A JU receiving a J7.0 (ACT = 0) message on a locally held track shall assume R² at the next transmission opportunity if local reporting eligibility remains and no remote report has been received on that track.
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: Describes the main flow action taken by the JU upon receiving a specific status message from another system.

evidence_cards.content: For a nonreal-time track with TQ field set to 0, a JU shall assume R² for that track when the track is locally updated by a new nonreal-time report.
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: Specifies the conditions under which the JU assumes responsibility (R²) during the process of integrating new nonreal-time data.

evidence_cards.content: A JU receiving a J2 PPLI message (with NPS Indicator set to Inactive, Conditional Radio Silence, or TDS Failure) from a JU that has R² of a locally held track may assume R² at the next transmission opportunity if local reporting eligibility remains and no remote report has been received on that track.
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: Describes the main flow action taken by the JU upon receiving a specific status message indicating another unit is unable to report.

evidence_cards.content: A JU relinquishes R² for a real-time Air, Surface (Maritime) or Land (Ground) track upon reception of a remote track report where remote TQ is greater than local TQ, or upon reception of a remote track report containing a TQ equal to the local TQ from a JU whose STN is greater than the local STN.
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: Defines the transition step where the actor (NonC2 JU) ceases responsibility and yields the track to the superior system, completing the data exchange cycle.

evidence_cards.content: A JU receiving a J7.0 message with the Track Management Action field set to value 0, Drop Track Report, on a locally held track shall assume R2 at the next opportunity to transmit the track if local reporting eligibility remains and a remote report has not been received on that track.
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: Defines the specific procedure for the actor (JU) upon receiving a Drop Track Report, a key step in the situational awareness maintenance flow.

evidence_cards.content: A JU without R2 for a nonreal-time track (TQ field value 0) shall assume R2 for that track when the track is locally updated by a new nonreal-time report.
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: Specifies the rule for assuming responsibility for nonreal-time tracks.

evidence_cards.content: A JU relinquishes R2 for a real-time track upon reception of a remote track report with TQ greater than local TQ.
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: Describes the condition under which the actor relinquishes track responsibility in favor of remote data.

evidence_cards.content: A JU with R2 on a track retains the responsibility until it is relinquished in accordance with the above rules or until the track is dropped.
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: Establishes the duration of the actor's responsibility.

evidence_cards.content: After applying all the above rules, a JU relinquishes R2 for a real-time track upon reception of a remote track report with TQ equal to the local TQ from a JU whose Source TN is greater than the local Source TN.
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: Specifies the tie-breaking rule for relinquishing track responsibility.

evidence_cards.content: The exchange of Ballistic Missile surveillance information on the interface requires procedures to recognize and resolve detected information differences between local data and data being reported on the interface.
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: Establishes the requirement for the main flow to include recognition and resolution of data differences.

evidence_cards.content: Detection and resolution of Identity, Exercise Indicator, Platform, Platform Activity, and Environment/Category differences are resolved by transmitting the appropriate J7 message.
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: Specifies the specific action (transmission of J7 message) taken to resolve discrepancies during the flow.

evidence_cards.content: The transmission of EW product information shall be terminated when the information is no longer valid or time-related update requirements are no longer met. The information may be purged in accordance with system design.

evidence_cards.content: When a JU drops or ceases reporting EW information, it shall transmit a J7.0 (ACT = 0) message on the interface. The J7.0 (ACT = 0) message shall not be transmitted on remote reports; remote reports may be automatically purged based on system criteria.
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: This details the specific termination message (J7.0 ACT=0) transmitted by the system to the NonC2 JU, marking the end of the information exchange.

evidence_cards.content: To support their missions, nonC2 JUs shall monitor the Surveillance NPG; however, they are prohibited from transmitting on this NPG.

evidence_cards.content: Remote surveillance track and point data available in the J3 series messages shall provide nonC2 JUs situational awareness and early warning information.
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: This confirms the data flow mechanism: J3 series messages containing remote surveillance data are received by the NonC2 JU.

evidence_cards.content: The origin of an EW LOB may be reported in three ways: a) Own Unit (Bearing Origin value 0, J3.7C2 word containing latitude/longitude); b) Another existing IU, track, or point (Bearing Origin value 0, Origin TN field set to designated IU's TN, J3.7C2 word); c) A designated position (Bearing Origin value 1, Origin TN field value 0, J3.7C2 word).

evidence_cards.slot_relevance: This specifies a restriction/alternative path where correlation is inhibited if data is redundant (both local).

evidence_cards.slot_relevance: Defines a specific handling path (retaining as remote track) that occurs when a Dropped Track Notification (TN) is not yet received, diverging from a standard correlation or discard process.

evidence_cards.content: During correlation, kinematic data (Latitude, Longitude, Course, Speed, Altitude, etc.) from a Dropped TN is transferred to the Retained TN only if the Dropped TN is a local or common local track.
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: Describes a conditional data retention flow (transfer of kinematic data) dependent on the track type, acting as a specific alternative handling procedure for track data.

evidence_cards.content: If ID conflict correlation restriction is not inhibited, and the ID/IAD of retained and Dropped TN are different but result in automatic acceptance, specific identification data is transferred to the Retained TN.
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: Details an alternative data transfer path for identification information triggered by a specific restriction state and acceptance criteria.

evidence_cards.content: When ID conflict correlation restriction is inhibited and the Identity of Retained TN and Dropped TN are different, the last reported Identity for the Dropped TN is processed as a J7.0 (ACT = 1) Identity Difference Report for the Retained TN.

evidence_cards.slot_relevance: Describes a data retention alternative when identities match under specific inhibition conditions.

evidence_cards.content: Any Dropped TN nonzero Mode I, II, or III IFF/SIF data for a mode where the Retained TN data is zero shall be transferred.

evidence_cards.content: Any change in the IFF/SIF code values from a No Data status to Valid Data or changes from Valid Data to other Valid Data will be reported as occurring.
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: Defines a specific reporting alternative path where the NonC2 JU must report data changes in the J3.2C1 and J3.3C1 words.

evidence_cards.content: Changes from a Valid Data value to a No Data status as a result of the clearing function (J7.5 (ACT = 0)) will not cause the transmission of a change report.
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: Defines a specific exception/alternative path where the NonC2 JU does not report a change in IFF/SIF data status.

evidence_cards.content: Tracks with Valid Data which subsequently fail to respond to interrogations shall not be changed to the No Data status unless a Clear action is taken.

evidence_cards.slot_relevance: This is a specific alternative branch triggered by pending command messages, diverging from standard decorrelation procedures to ensure data integrity before communication.

evidence_cards.content: If TN A is controlled by the own unit (indicated by a J10.5 Controlling Unit Report message), the system shall not automatically decorrelate; manual decorrelation triggers an alert for operator action to report termination of control.

evidence_cards.content: Following the receipt of an original or retransmitted message (J3.0 or J3.5 with PTI = 0), the system state for the Periodic Report Indicator (PER IND) is updated to value 2 to indicate a periodic update of points.
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: Describes the system's handling of update indicators after receiving surveillance data, a key part of the situational awareness postcondition.

evidence_cards.content: System state includes restrictions where automatic correlation between two tracks is inhibited if there is an Identity (ID) difference which constitutes a conflict; this automatic inhibition can be overridden only via an initialization parameter and operator selectable capability, subject to interface coordination and promulgation to all C2 IUs.
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: Describes a specific post-use-case state rule regarding track data integrity and correlation limitations for the NonC2 JU.

evidence_cards.content: System state includes restrictions where automatic correlation is inhibited if the two tracks have different Mode II codes and the local Mode II code is current; this automatic inhibition can be overridden only via an initialization parameter and operator selectable capability, subject to interface coordination.
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: Describes a specific post-use-case state rule regarding Mode II code conflicts for the NonC2 JU.

evidence_cards.content: System state includes restrictions where automatic correlation is inhibited if both tracks are locally derived real-time tracks (being updated with local positional data).
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: Defines a state condition where the system must prevent duplication of locally derived track data.

evidence_cards.content: System state includes rules for handling tracks with the Strength field set to a value greater than 1, and specifies that systems shall not inhibit correlation if either track has Strength set to No Statement.
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: Describes the system's state regarding correlation constraints based on the 'Strength' field attribute of track data.

evidence_cards.content: Tracks that have Valid Data status and subsequently fail to respond to interrogations are not automatically changed to a No Data status unless a Clear action is taken by the operator or system.
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: This defines the state maintenance rule for valid tracks in the NonC2 JU's database after the monitoring and receiving process is complete.

evidence_cards.content: A JU shall not report a TQ value which has an associated positional accuracy which is better than that associated with own unit's current geodetic position quality.
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: Defines a system state constraint for data reporting after receiving or processing situational awareness data.

evidence_cards.content: A JU shall not artificially increase TQ between sensor inputs.
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: Defines a constraint on the state of Target Quality (TQ) data integrity after receiving inputs.

evidence_cards.content: For tracks not locally acquired but obtained via a J12.6 Target Sorting message from a nonC² JU, the receiving JU shall initially assign the TQ value specified in Table 4.4-7 and extrapolate the target's position to the time of transmission.
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: Describes the resulting system state and data processing actions (extrapolation and TQ assignment) for specific incoming data tracks.

evidence_cards.content: If a JU has correlated local sensor data for a track, the TQ assignment rules for tracks obtained via J12.6 Target Sorting messages do not need to be applied.
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: Defines the final state condition for track data processing when correlation is achieved.

evidence_cards.content: The NonC2 JU assumes Responsibility (R²) for a nonreal-time track when the track is locally updated by a new nonreal-time report and the remote Track Quality (TQ) is set to value 0.
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: Describes the state change (Assumption of R²) that occurs upon successful processing of a nonreal-time update.

evidence_cards.content: The time value reported in a nonreal-time track report shall represent the time at which the positional data are valid and shall be reported in the hour and minute fields of the J3 Amplitude Continuation word.
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: Defines the data format state for the nonreal-time report after it has been processed.

evidence_cards.content: If a J7.0 (ACT = 0) message is received on a locally held track and no remote report has been received, the NonC2 JU assumes R².
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: Describes the postcondition state (Assumption of R²) triggered by the receipt of a drop message on a track.

evidence_cards.content: The NonC2 JU ensures that only the JU having the best positional data is reporting the track (the R² rule) by comparing local TQ to the remote TQ; if the received remote TQ is greater than the local TQ, or if a remote track report is received with a TQ greater than the local STN (Track Number), the NonC2 JU assumes R².
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: Describes the resulting state of track reporting authority (R²) based on the comparison of received quality parameters.

evidence_cards.content: The NonC2 JU transmits a track report for Air, Surface (Maritime), or Land (Ground) tracks only when it has assumed R², which it retains until it is relinquished or the track is dropped.
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: Describes the system state regarding transmission eligibility following the assumption of R².

evidence_cards.content: The NonC2 JU assumes R² on a common track if its local TQ at the time of transmission exceeds the received TQ by 2 or more.
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: Defines the specific threshold condition for establishing the reporting responsibility state.

evidence_cards.content: A ballistic missile track shall maintain R² (Responsibility) on the related Impact Point as the latest IU to report on the missile's flight path.
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: Describes the responsibility state maintained by the system after receiving and reporting on a ballistic missile track.

evidence_cards.content: Upon transmission or reception of a Drop Track Report, a JU with R² of the Launch or Impact Point shall transmit those messages within 30 seconds with the Time Function field set to value 3 (Arrival Time).
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: Defines the specific reporting behavior and timing constraint required as part of the post-report state.

evidence_cards.content: Any subsequent reports of the Impact or Launch Point shall be transmitted with the Related Track Number field of the J3.05 message set to the same value as the initial report.
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: Specifies the data association state required for the JU maintaining the track.

evidence_cards.content: There is no requirement to continue transmitting a missile impact point message after the actual Impact Point message has been sent.
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: Defines the termination condition for the reporting state of the Impact Point.

evidence_cards.content: The originator of a J3.0 Ballistic Missile Launch Point retains R² as long as the originator remains active and reports the point.
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: Defines the condition under which the system maintains responsibility for the Launch Point.

evidence_cards.content: Track correlation prevents and eliminates dual designations by ensuring each ballistic missile track reported on the interface represents a single data point.
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: Describes the integrity state achieved by the system after performing correlation.

evidence_cards.content: The NonC2 JU retains Responsibility (R2) for a track until it is relinquished in accordance with established rules or until the track is dropped.
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: Defines the post-use case state regarding the NonC2 JU's ownership/responsibility of received or locally generated tracks.

evidence_cards.content: The NonC2 JU assumes Responsibility (R2) for a ballistic missile track without necessarily assuming R2 for the associated launch point.
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: Defines the specific post-use case state for ballistic missile surveillance data integration.

evidence_cards.content: Surveillance information includes Point surveillance data contained in the J3.0 Reference Point message and the J3.1 Emergency Point message.
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: Specifies the specific message types containing the data that the NonC2 JU has successfully received as a postcondition.

evidence_cards.content: Surveillance information includes Air and Surface (Maritime) surveillance data contained in the J3.2 Air Track message and the J3.3 Surface (Maritime) Track message.
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: Specifies the specific message types containing the data that the NonC2 JU has successfully received as a postcondition.

evidence_cards.content: Surveillance information includes Subsurface (Maritime) surveillance data contained in the J3.4 Subsurface (Maritime) Track message.
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: Specifies the specific message types containing the data that the NonC2 JU has successfully received as a postcondition.

evidence_cards.content: Surveillance information includes Land (Ground) surveillance data contained in the J3.5 Land (Ground) Point/Track message.
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: Specifies the specific message types containing the data that the NonC2 JU has successfully received as a postcondition.

evidence_cards.content: Surveillance information includes Space and Ballistic Missile surveillance data contained in the J3.6 Space Track message.
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: Specifies the specific message types containing the data that the NonC2 JU has successfully received as a postcondition.

evidence_cards.content: Surveillance information includes Electronic Warfare surveillance data contained in the J3.7 EW Product Information message.
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: Specifies the specific message types containing the data that the NonC2 JU has successfully received as a postcondition.

evidence_cards.content: Upon receipt of a J2 PPLI message, the NonC2 JU inserts a surveillance track report using a new track number and performs the necessary correlation and conflict processing to ensure duplicative information is not transmitted.
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: Describes the final state of the local track database after the use case successfully processes a new track (Integration).

evidence_cards.content: If a correlation is found for which another C² JU has R² and the Track Numbers (TNs) are different, the system state transitions to transmitting a J7.2 (RV = 2) Correlation message, ceasing to report the surveillance track, and dropping the existing track.
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: Defines the system state post-action when a track is successfully handed off to another platform.

evidence_cards.content: If a correlation is found for which another C² JU has R² and the Track Numbers (TNs) are the same, the system state transitions to accepting the PPLI information into the surveillance database and disregarding the J3 surveillance data for that specific track.
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: Defines the system state post-action when the platform retains data provided by the responsible unit.

evidence_cards.content: If altitude is specified in the J3 message, the 'Altitude, 100 Ft 1' and 'Altitude, 100 Ft 2' fields shall be reported in each J3 word transmitted field.
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: Describes the final state of the data fields after the NonC2 JU processes and incorporates altitude data.

evidence_cards.content: When only one altitude is provided, 'Altitude, 100 Ft 1' is used to report the altitude, and 'Altitude, 100 Ft 2' is set to value 1023, which indicates No Statement.
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: Defines the specific system state and default value configuration for altitude fields when partial altitude data is received.

evidence_cards.content: The Exercise Indicator field in J3.0 messages is set to value 0 for all Point Type and Point Amplification values other than value 6 (Area, Hazard) combined with value 3 (Allied MEZ) or 4 (Hostile MEZ).
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: Defines the state of the J3.0 message fields upon receipt and processing by the NonC2 JU.

evidence_cards.content: Following the receipt of an original or retransmitted J3.0 or J3.5 message, the NonC2 JU sets the Periodic Report Indicator (PER IND) to value 1 to indicate the periodic update of point data.
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: Defines the state change of the PER IND field after successfully receiving and processing surveillance updates.

evidence_cards.content: Periodic updates transmitted to the NonC2 JU are identified by the Periodic Report Indicator (PER IND) set to value 2, allowing the JU to process point updates distinct from the initial report.
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: Defines the specific indicator value the NonC2 JU expects to recognize periodic updates in the post-reception state.

evidence_cards.content: Responses to Data Update Requests for multi-point areas or multi-segmented lines are transmitted with the Periodic Report Indicator (PER IND) set to value 0 and the Response Indicator set to value 1.
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: Defines the specific message indicator values used by the NonC2 JU (or received by it) to identify data update responses.

evidence_cards.content: If the two tracks have an Identity (ID) difference which constitutes a conflict, the system shall not automatically correlate the tracks, unless inhibited by an initialization parameter.
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: Defines a specific post-condition for the correlation process: tracks with conflicting IDs must remain uncorrelated by default, ensuring distinct targets are not merged.

evidence_cards.content: If the two tracks have different Mode II codes, and the local Mode II code is current, the system shall not automatically correlate the tracks.
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: Defines a specific post-condition for correlation: differing Mode II codes prevent automatic correlation, maintaining data integrity based on transponder identity.

evidence_cards.content: If both tracks are locally derived real-time tracks (updated with local positional data), the system shall not automatically correlate them.
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: Defines a specific post-condition to prevent redundant correlation between two independently tracked local sources.

evidence_cards.content: If either track has the Strength field set to a value greater than 1, the system shall not inhibit correlation (i.e., correlation is allowed/expected).
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: Defines a post-condition constraint regarding track strength, specifying when correlation is permissible despite other factors.

evidence_cards.content: The system (JU) is capable of assuming Responsibility (R²) for a previously-reported track, which involves processing specific platform activity fields (Platform, Platform Activity, Specific Type, and Special Interest Indicator) for retransmission and operator appreciation.
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: Describes the system state (assumption of R²) that can occur as a postcondition of receiving the data and performing the correlation logic.

evidence_cards.content: If the system assumes Responsibility (R²) and accepts track values for retransmission, it shall retransmit those values unless it holds locally derived data (other than No Statement) for fields that differ; in that case, the locally derived data is reported.
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: Defines the state of data consistency (local vs. remote) and the resulting postcondition state (reporting locally derived data over received data for specific identity fields).

evidence_cards.content: Regardless of locally derived data, non-No Statement data for Platform, Platform Activity, and Specific Type fields received from a controlling unit must be retransmitted.
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: Establishes a specific system state where received control data overrides local state for these specific identity fields.

evidence_cards.content: If the Special Interest Indicator is set to value 1, the system shall retransmit it as value 1 when assuming R².
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: Establishes a specific data state constraint (preserving value 1) for the Special Interest Indicator field as a postcondition of assuming responsibility.

evidence_cards.content: A JU relinquishes Responsibility (R²) for a real-time track (Air, Surface, or Land) upon reception of a remote track report with a greater Track Quality (TQ) value, or upon reception of a remote track report with an equal TQ value from a JU with a greater Station Number (STN).
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: This clause specifies the exact condition under which the NonC2 JU's state transitions from having Responsibility (R²) to relinquishing it, representing the completion of the data sharing interaction regarding a track.

evidence_cards.content: A JU retains responsibility for a track until the responsibility is formally relinquished in accordance with the defined rules (such as those in paragraph i) or until the track is dropped.
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: This defines the persistence of the system state (Responsibility) following the completion of a data exchange or reporting cycle.

evidence_cards.content: The system requires procedures to recognize and resolve information differences when exchanging Air, Surface (Maritime), and Land (Ground) surveillance information on the interface.
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: Describes the resulting system state/capability established after processing surveillance information: the resolution of information conflicts.

evidence_cards.content: A JU with R² for the related ballistic missile track maintains R² on the related Impact Point.
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: Describes the state of the track management (responsibility maintenance) as a result of receiving impact data.

evidence_cards.content: The JU transmits the Impact Point and/or Launch Point messages with the 'Related 2 Expt Number field of the J3.0/5 message set to value 0 (No ShatterTime Function field set to value 3, Arrival Time).
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: Specifies the required action and specific field values in the system message buffer to report the impact data correctly.

evidence_cards.content: A pre-launch indication of an expected Impact Point is transmitted by setting the Time Function field to Arrival Time and the HmrrPredicted Time to Impact field to less than N6 Seconds.
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: Defines the specific data states (field values) that must be populated when transmitting a pre-launch indication.

evidence_cards.content: A pre-launch indication of an expected Launch Point is transmitted by setting the Time Function field to Departure Time.
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: Defines the specific data state (Time Function field) required for expected launch point reporting.

evidence_cards.content: The time of the launch is reported to the nearest second with the Time Function field set to value 4 (Departure Time).
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: Defines the specific format and precision for launch time reporting.

evidence_cards.content: The originator of a J3.0 Ballistic Missile Launch Point retains R² as long as the originator remains active and reports the point.
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: Defines the system state regarding Responsibility (R²) after a launch point message is processed.

evidence_cards.content: The NonC2 JU is prohibited from transmitting on the Surveillance NPG and is restricted to monitoring.
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: Describes the system state restriction (receive-only mode on the Surveillance NPG) that exists after the use case is established.

evidence_cards.content: Upon assuming Responsibility (R²) of an Interface Unit (IU) due to inactive or limited status (e.g., missing J2 PPLI for 40-60 seconds), the NonC2 JU reports the IU as a track or point on the Surveillance Network PG with the Identity reported as Friend, and maintains the Track Number and Platform Activity values received in previous PPLI messages.

evidence_cards.slot_relevance: This describes the specific system state and reporting action (postcondition) taken when the use case handles a stale or inactive track.

evidence_cards.content: When reporting a track or point assuming R² for an inactive IU, the PPLI Track Number and Identity Indicator fields shall be reported as value 1.

evidence_cards.slot_relevance: This specifies the exact data values the system must use to report the track after handling the exception/alternative flow condition.

evidence_cards.content: If the position or other data in a PPLI meet decorrelation criteria, the system state changes such that the C² JU initiates a surveillance track report with locally held data using a new track number.
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: This describes the resulting system state after a decorrelation event is detected during the correlation process.

evidence_cards.content: The track's Simulation Indicator shall not change.
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: Describes the state of the track after successful processing or attempted status change; the indicator must remain stable unless the track is dropped.

evidence_cards.content: If the track is being received from an FJU, a change from live to simulated shall be accepted.
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: Defines the accepted final state for tracks received from Force/Joint Units (FJU), allowing a transition from live to simulated status.

evidence_cards.content: Force Tell and Emergency Indicators are provided in J3 messages to indicate force tell and/or emergency conditions.
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: Describes the state of the data fields (Force Tell and Emergency Indicators) within the received J3 messages.

evidence_cards.content: When Force Tell and Emergency Indicators are set, they allow messages to override all operator controllable data filters.
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: Describes the post-reception processing state where high-priority alerts force visibility of the data regardless of user filters.

evidence_cards.content: Indicators are set and cleared as specified in paragraph 4.7.1.4.
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: Defines the standard for the final state of the Alert Indicators.

evidence_cards.content: Remote tracks/points are automatically dropped after a specified time interval has elapsed since the last report.
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: Describes the time-based lifecycle postcondition for remote track/point data.

evidence_cards.content: The JU shall not transmit a J7.0 (ACT = 0) message on a purged remote track/point.
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: Defines a communication postcondition for the system when performing a purge (no drop track message is sent for remote data).

evidence_cards.content: The system state is established where Valid Data or No Data conditions are determined for IFF/SIF surveillance data for established tracks, based on received code responses and interrogation criteria.
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: This defines the specific data state (Valid Data vs. No Data) that exists within the system after the reception and correlation processes described in the main flow are complete.

evidence_cards.content: The system state for IFF/SIF code values reflects the change that has occurred (e.g., from No Data to Valid Data, or from one Valid Data value to another Valid Data).
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: This confirms the system maintains the state of the most recent code change resulting from the interaction.

evidence_cards.content: If the JU has R² on a track but does not have the TQ field set to value 0, the JU shall assume R² for that track when the track is locally updated by a new track report.
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: This is a postcondition of receiving and processing surveillance data, describing the updated state of track responsibility.

evidence_cards.content: A JU relinquishes R² for a real-time track upon receipt of a remote track report in which the remote Track Number (TN) is greater than the local TN, or upon receipt of a remote track report containing a TQ equal to the local TQ from a JU whose STN is greater than the local STN.
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: This is a postcondition describing the transfer of track responsibility based on specific message contents.

evidence_cards.content: When the JU ceases reporting a track because it has relinquished R² to another JU, the track is dropped when the next track is logged.
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: This is a postcondition describing the final state of the track database upon relinquishing responsibility.

evidence_cards.content: A JU with R² on a track retains responsibility until it is relinquished in accordance with the R² rules or the track is dropped.
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: This defines the persistent system state regarding responsibility maintenance.

evidence_cards.content: For a nonreal-time track (TQ = 0), the JU assumes R² at the next opportunity to transmit the track if the J7.0 (ACT = 0) Drop Track Report is received and local reporting eligibility remains.
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: Defines a specific post-receipt state change (assuming R²) for the NonC2 JU based on the Drop Track Report trigger.

evidence_cards.content: For a real-time track, a JU assumes R² for a nonreal-time track when the track is locally updated by a new nonreal-time report.
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: Defines the condition under which a nonreal-time track is established as R² for the NonC2 JU.

evidence_cards.content: A JU relinquishes R² for a real-time track upon reception of a remote track report with TQ greater than local TQ.
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: Defines the termination condition (postcondition) for the NonC2 JU's responsibility on a real-time track.

evidence_cards.content: A JU with R² retains responsibility until relinquished in accordance with the rules or until the track is dropped.
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: Describes the persistent state of the NonC2 JU's responsibility during the use case's lifespan.

evidence_cards.content: A JU relinquishes R² for a real-time track upon reception of a remote track report with TQ equal to the local TQ from a JU whose Source TN is greater than the local Source TN.
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: Defines a specific post-receipt state change (relinquishing R²) based on Source TN comparison.

evidence_cards.content: A unit assuming R² for a ballistic missile track need not assume R² for the associated launch point; the unit no longer holding R² may continue to report the launch point.
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: Describes the resulting state of data reporting for associated entities (launch points) after track responsibility shifts.

evidence_cards.content: A JU reporting a ballistic missile track with the Lost Track Indicator field set to value 1 is assumed to have a TQ of 5 (1-15, 1) less than that being reported.
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: Defines the state of the Track Quality (TQ) field following a specific status report (Lost Track) received.

evidence_cards.content: The NonC2 JU shall not transmit on the Surveillance NPG.
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: This is a final state restriction for the NonC2 JU after it has established its role as a receiver on the network.

evidence_cards.content: Subsurface tracks shall not be correlated with IUs.
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: Defines a specific postcondition for the use case: the exclusion of subsurface tracks from correlation processes.

evidence_cards.content: The system has received the data, performed the necessary correlation and decorrelation processing, and the Reference Points (including Exercise MEZ) are in the active state within the Surveillance NPG's data structure.
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: This describes the state of the Reference Points after the reception and processing flow described in the use case.

evidence_cards.content: The Periodic Report Indicator (PER IND) is set to value 1 for the original or retransmitted message, and set to value 2 for subsequent periodic updates, indicating the state of the periodic reporting cycle.
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: This defines the specific field state in the received messages after the periodic update flow.

evidence_cards.content: Emergency points are updated periodically and are in a state where they will be terminated via the J3.4 message if the time has elapsed, ensuring data freshness.
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: This describes the condition of Emergency Points after the reception and update process is complete.

evidence_cards.content: After successful correlation, the system state is governed by Correlation Restrictions where C2 JUs do not automatically correlate two tracks if any of the following conditions exist: (1) Identity (ID) difference constitutes a conflict; (2) The two tracks have different Mode II codes and the local Mode II code is current; (3) Both tracks are locally derived real-time tracks; (4) Either track has the Strength field set to a value greater than 1.
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: Defines the final system state and validation logic for tracked data after the processing flow completes. Specifically, it describes the restrictions on correlation which are the outcome of the receiving process.

evidence_cards.content: When a remote report being tested for correlation is a J2.0 Indirect PPLI message with the Originator E/C field set to value 0 (Surface) or 3 (Air), the system processes it for correlation like a J3.2 air or J3.3 surface (maritime) track with TQ = 7.
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: Specifies the post-processing state assignment for specific J2.0 Indirect PPLI message types, ensuring they are handled as standard surface or air tracks with a defined Target Quality (TQ).

evidence_cards.content: If the correlation is successful, the Track Number (TN) to be retained shall be tested for decorrelation in accordance with paragraph 4.4.4.3.2a before executing the correlation, except the test shall be conducted only once.
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: This defines a specific post-correlation system state (decorrelation test on the retained TN) that occurs after a resolution of the ID conflict.

evidence_cards.content: If the correlation is successful and the own unit holds the Dropped TN as a local or common local track, the system state is updated such that the Retained TN is designated as a common local track.
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: This describes the final system state of track designation following a successful correlation and drop of an existing track.

evidence_cards.content: If the correlation is successful and the own unit has Responsibility (R²) for the Dropped TN, the system state transitions to retaining the Dropped TN as a remote track, and the system shall not reattempt to correlate the Retained TN and the Dropped TN for a period of 60 seconds after the drop message transmission.
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: This specifies the resulting track state (remote) and the correlation inhibition constraint (60-second wait) that exist after successfully dropping a track for which the unit holds responsibility.

evidence_cards.content: The system ensures that the NonC2 JU, when operating with valid local IFF/SIF data, is not confused by remote data changes by relying on the R2 JU to transmit only when data changes or at a reduced periodic rate (1/8 the basic message rate for real-time tracks).
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: Describes the post-state of the surveillance reporting interface where the NonC2 JU successfully receives data without processing redundant updates from the primary source (R2 JU).

evidence_cards.content: IFF/SIF code values are successfully validated and stored in the NonC2 JU's data model, classified either as 'No Data' (zeroes in the Mode Code field) or 'Valid Data' (nonzero codes confirmed by at least two successive interrogations or manual entry).

evidence_cards.content: The system state results in a JU assuming Responsibility (R2) after approximately 40 seconds of no remote report on a locally held Air or Surface track, or 120 seconds for a locally held Land track.
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: This is a postcondition of the tracking system: defining the specific state change (assuming R2) triggered by the passage of time without data reception.

evidence_cards.content: The system state results in a JU assuming R2 at the next opportunity upon receiving a J2 PPLI message with specific NPS Indicators (Inactive, Conditional Radio Silence, TDS Failure) from a JU that has R2.

evidence_cards.content: The system state is that a JU relinquishes R2 for a real-time track upon reception of a remote track report with a greater remote TQ, or a remote report with equal TQ from a JU with a greater STN.
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: Describes the postcondition of losing R2 based on specific criteria of incoming report data (TQ and STN).

evidence_cards.content: The system state is that a JU with R2 on a track retains that responsibility until it is relinquished via the specific rules listed or until the track is dropped.
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: Defines the persistence of the postcondition (retention of R2) until specific state changes occur.

evidence_cards.content: The minimum wait time before reporting air and surface tracks is 12 seconds, and for land tracks is 48 seconds.

evidence_cards.slot_relevance: Specifies the state requirements and timing constraints the system must satisfy after the NonC2 JU achieves Active status or returns from Inactive status, which constitutes a postcondition of the receiving and processing phase.

evidence_cards.content: System design must allow for longer wait times as well as an override in cases where operational necessity requires a shorter wait time or none at all.

evidence_cards.slot_relevance: Describes a flexibility requirement for the system state, allowing the NonC2 JU to bypass the standard postcondition wait times under operational necessity.

evidence_cards.content: A JU reporting 'Lost Track' (TQ field = 1) is assumed to have a Target Quality (TQ) of 5 (1-15,1) less than that being reported.
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: Specifies the system state regarding Target Quality interpretation when receiving a 'Lost Track' message.

evidence_cards.content: If a JU is reporting 'Lost Track' with a TQ of 15, the JU holding 'Tracking' data may assume R² with a TQ of 14 regardless of the time tag on the remote track.

evidence_cards.content: A JU assumes R² on a ballistic missile track if it has not received a remote report for a locally held track for 25 seconds.
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: Defines a specific time-based postcondition for assuming responsibility of a ballistic missile track.

evidence_cards.content: The R² assumption rule (25 seconds) only applies when the appropriate J2 message received with the Track Indicator set to value 0 (Tracking).
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: Specifies the boundary condition for the R² time-out postcondition.

evidence_cards.content: The information is no longer valid or time-related update requirements are no longer met.
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: Describes the data validity state (valid or expired) after the data handling flow is complete.

evidence_cards.content: The information may be purged in accordance with system parameters.
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: Describes the data retention state (purged) following the termination of data reporting.

evidence_cards.content: The J7.0 (ACT = 0) message shall not be transmitted on remote reports.
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: Describes the network transmission state (no drop messages sent for remote reports) after the use case logic for termination is applied.

evidence_cards.content: Remote reports may be automatically purged based on system criteria.
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: Describes the data retention state (auto-purged) for remote reports upon termination.

evidence_cards.content: If a correlation is not found between received PPLI data and local track data, the NonC2 JU integrates the received J2 PPLI report into its surveillance database as part of the surveillance picture.
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: Describes a primary state transition where the system accepts and integrates remote data, constituting a successful outcome for a received track.

evidence_cards.content: If a correlation is found with a track for which another C² JU has R² and the Track Numbers (TNs) are the same, the NonC2 JU accepts the PPLI information into its surveillance database and disregards the J3 surveillance data for that specific track.
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: Describes the system state after successful correlation: the system acknowledges the remote track's ownership and discards the local surveillance track in favor of the PPLI report.

evidence_cards.content: If the position or other data in a PPLI meet a system's decorrelation criteria, the PPLI and local track data are decorrelated, and the NonC2 JU initiates a surveillance track report with locally held data using a new track number.
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: Describes the postcondition following a decorrelation event, where the system transitions to an independent track state with a new identifier.

evidence_cards.content: The NonC2 JU shall ensure that the Periodic Report Indicator (PER IND) is set to value 1 following the receipt of an original or retransmitted message.
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: Defines the specific state of the PER IND field within the received message data structure after a successful update event, confirming correct parsing of the message header.

evidence_cards.content: New local tracks shall be transmitted (reported to the interface) only if an automatic correlation attempt has been made and failed on an initial correlation test, or if a tentative correlation is found on the initial test but fails on the next test.
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: Defines the post-use-case state for new local tracks: they are only reported as 'New' if correlation with existing data fails.

evidence_cards.content: A new local track that successfully correlates with another track on each of the first two correlation tests shall be held as a common local track.
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: Defines the post-use-case state for tracks that are successfully correlated with remote data.

evidence_cards.content: A new local track that has been selectively released by an operator for reporting shall be transmitted regardless of the results of correlation testing.
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: Defines the post-use-case state for tracks released manually, overriding automatic correlation logic.

evidence_cards.content: Upon successful correlation of a Dropped Track Number (TN) to a Retained TN, all data specified for the Dropped TN is transferred to the Retained TN in accordance with the reporting rules for the Retained TN.

evidence_cards.slot_relevance: Describes the final state of the track data after a successful correlation and decorrelation event, which is the ultimate result of the data processing workflow.

evidence_cards.content: If a Dropped Track Number is automatically selected (e.g., due to conflict), it is dropped and its data is transferred to the Retained TN.

evidence_cards.slot_relevance: Details the outcome of the TN selection process, establishing the final tracking status (Dropped vs. Retained) for the system.

evidence_cards.content: After a Dropped Track is identified and processed, the system retains the Dropped TN as a remote track for a period of 60 seconds, during which the system shall not reattempt to correlate the Retained TN and the Dropped TN.
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: Defines a specific system state (cooldown/ignore period) and time threshold that exists immediately following the completion of the correlation logic.

evidence_cards.content: If the NonC2 JU has a target track obtained via a J12.6 Target Sorting message, it shall initially assign a Target Quality (TQ) value from Table 4.4-7 to the track, provided the track's positional accuracy is better than the JU's own unit's current geodetic position quality. The JU must extrapolate the received target's position to the time of transmission and assign the TQ value.

evidence_cards.slot_relevance: This detail specifies the exact processing logic and state initialization (TQ assignment) that occurs as a postcondition when the NonC2 JU receives a J12.6 target track during the use case.

evidence_cards.content: For a track obtained via a J12.6 Target Sorting message, the assigned Target Quality (TQ) values are determined by the following translation from Source Information Quality (TPQ): TPQ 0 results in TQ 6, TPQ 1 results in TQ 8, TPQ 2 results in TQ 9, and TPQ 3 results in TQ 10. TPQ is defined as the area (in square data miles) where there is a 95% probability the target is actually located at the time of report.
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: This table defines the specific quantitative values assigned to the track state (TQ) upon receipt of J12.6 data, which is a concrete system state.

evidence_cards.content: A JU with Responsibility (R²) on a track retains the responsibility until it is relinquished in accordance with established rules or until the track is dropped.
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: Describes the final system state regarding track ownership after the process of receiving, correlating, and maintaining situational data is complete.

evidence_cards.content: Ballistic missile covariance data includes the best estimate of both tracking errors and statistical estimates of biases produced by emplacement errors, alignment errors, and other systematic errors.
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: Defines the specific system state of the covariance data available to the NonC2 JU after successfully processing ballistic missile tracks.

evidence_cards.content: Ballistic missile covariance data is transmitted using the root variances of the covariance matrix and elements of the Cholesky decomposition of the precompensated correlation matrix.
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: Describes the final data structure/format of the state vector after processing, confirming the specific system state achieved by the NonC2 JU.

evidence_cards.content: A JU reporting 'Lost Track' (Field set to value 1) is assumed to have a TQ of 5 (1-15,1) less than that being reported.
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: Specifies the exact system state (TQ value) resulting from the 'Lost Track' condition after data processing.

evidence_cards.content: A JU assumes R² (Responsibility) on a ballistic missile track if it has not received a remote report on a locally held track for 25 seconds, provided the Track Indicator is set to value 0 (Tracking).
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: Describes the specific post-condition state (assumption of R²) triggered by a lack of incoming updates over a defined time threshold (25 seconds).

evidence_cards.content: If a remote report is identified as a nonreal-time report with TQ field value 2, the track is locally updated by a new nonreal-time report, and a JU reporting such a track has R² regardless of the TQ value.
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: Describes the specific post-condition state (R² assignment and track update type) resulting from the receipt of a specific type of nonreal-time report.

evidence_cards.content: Remote surveillance track and point data is available in the J3 series messages.
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: Describes the system state (availability of data) that exists to support the NonC2 JU receiving situational awareness.
